name: RobotEra
summary:
RobotEra develops embodied AI systems, robot platforms and dexterous hands. Its work connects complete robot hardware with models for perception, task understanding and physical action, with logistics identified as an early focus for commercial applications.

The company presents its products as a connected family of embodied systems, including the XHAND line of robotic hands. Its research also explores world models as a foundation for robot intelligence beyond individual action policies. By combining manipulation hardware, learning systems and practical operating scenarios, RobotEra aims to expand the range of work that robots can perform in real environments.
